description: Defines the DateRange class for managing date intervals, including methods for setting ranges like today, yesterday, this week, last week, last 7 days, specific months, and formatting dates for display and filenames.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: Represents a period between two dates with methods to set and manipulate date ranges such as today, yesterday, weeks, months, and custom ranges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DateRange object, defaulting to current date/time if none provided.

methods.name: newToday
methods.description: Creates a DateRange object set to today.

methods.name: useToday
methods.description: Sets the range to today.

methods.name: useYesterday
methods.description: Sets the range to yesterday.

methods.name: useThisWeek
methods.description: Sets the range to the current week.

methods.name: useLastWeek
methods.description: Sets the range to the previous week.

methods.name: useLast7Days
methods.description: Sets the range to the last 7 days.

methods.name: useLastDays
methods.description: Sets the range to the last specified number of days.

methods.name: useLastMonth
methods.description: Sets the range to last month.

methods.name: useThisMonth
methods.description: Sets the range to the current month.

methods.name: useNextMonth
methods.description: Sets the range to next month.

methods.name: useMonthRemainder
methods.description: Sets the range from today to the end of the current month.

methods.name: useTextSpecifier
methods.description: Sets the range based on a textual specifier like 'today', 'yesterday', etc.

methods.name: _startOfPreviousMonth
methods.description: Calculates the start date of the previous month.

methods.name: _startOfNextMonth
methods.description: Calculates the start date of the next month.

methods.name: _midnight
methods.description: Returns a Date object set to midnight of the given date.

methods.name: _nextMidnight
methods.description: Returns the midnight of the next day.

methods.name: _startOfMonth
methods.description: Returns the first day of the month for a given date.

methods.name: _add24Hours
methods.description: Adds 24 hours to a date.

methods.name: _subtractDays
methods.description: Subtracts a number of days from a date.

methods.name: _addDays
methods.description: Adds a number of days to a date.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the range.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the range.

methods.name: useValuesFromQueryArray
methods.description: Sets range based on query array values.

methods.name: setDateRangeByInclusiveDates
methods.description: Sets range with start and end dates.

methods.name: setDateRangeByNaturalHumanStrings
methods.description: Sets range from string representations of dates.

methods.name: getStartSql
methods.description: Returns SQL string for start date.

methods.name: getEndSqlForComparingTimestamps
methods.description: Returns SQL string for end date for timestamp comparison.

methods.name: getEndSqlForComparingDays
methods.description: Returns SQL string for end date for day comparison.

methods.name: getStartDateForDisplay
methods.description: Returns formatted start date for display.

methods.name: getEndDateForDisplay
methods.description: Returns formatted end date for display.

methods.name: formatDateForDisplay
methods.description: Formats a date for human display.

methods.name: formatDateForFilename
methods.description: Formats a date for filename use.

methods.name: getStartDateForFilename
methods.description: Returns filename-friendly start date.

methods.name: getEndDateForFilename
methods.description: Returns filename-friendly end date.

methods.name: getHumanEndDate
methods.description: Returns the date representing the end of the range minus one day.

methods.name: countDays
methods.description: Returns the total number of days in the range.

methods.name: countDayOfWeekOccurances
methods.description: Counts how many times a specific weekday occurs within the range.

methods.name: endsAfter
methods.description: Checks if this range ends after another range.

methods.name: startsBefore
methods.description: Checks if this range starts before another range.

methods.name: endsBeforeStarts
methods.description: Checks if this range ends before it starts (empty range).

methods.name: setStartOfWeek
methods.description: Sets the first day of the week.

methods.name: startOfThisWeek
methods.description: Returns the date for the start of the current week based on 'now' and first day of week.
